title: Existing Unit-Specific Interactive Learning Laboratories
disclaimer: Nine existing public unit-specific laboratory pages in this GitHub portal; these are not independently verified as Google Sites embeds, and neither their provenance nor assessment/SLO mapping is asserted.

labs.title: Unit 2 — Interactive Vector Mastery Lab
labs.description: Three interactive skill modes with 36 original calculation challenges, two-value checking, hints, worked methods, vector diagrams and dot/cross angle exploration. Self-practice is local and does not save grades.

labs.title: Unit 3 — Interactive Motion Laboratory
labs.description: Manipulate constant acceleration, inspect signed velocity–time/displacement–time graphs, and animate ideal projectile flight with adjustable speed, angle and time.

labs.title: Unit 3 Part 2 — Air Resistance & Collision Explorer
labs.description: Qualitative air-drag comparison and adjustable, signed one-dimensional ideal head-on elastic / perfectly inelastic collision model with momentum, kinetic-energy and relative-speed readouts.

labs.title: Unit 4 — Interactive Radian & Rotation Laboratory
labs.description: Adjust signed degrees and radius, see the arc/radian relation, model a spinning wheel with angular velocity/acceleration, reversal/distance distinction, displacement and velocity graphs; includes textbook Example 4.1.

labs.title: Unit 4 — Interactive Centripetal Force Laboratory
labs.description: Adjust mass, tangential speed and radius; view velocity tangent to the circle and net force inward, compare force scaling, calculate friction-free bank angle, choose actual force mechanisms and reproduce NBF Example 4.2.

labs.title: Unit 4 — Weightlessness & Artificial Gravity Interactive Lab
labs.description: Schematic satellite free fall plus ideal rotating-ring station; vary radius, rpm and person mass, calculate floor normal, acceleration, rpm, period and frequency; includes NBF Example 4.4 and Assignment 4.4 presets.

labs.title: Unit 4 — Torque, Inertia & Angular Momentum Interactive Laboratory
labs.description: Model mass-dependent inertia of point mass, hoop, disc or sphere; apply net external torque and read momentum, angular acceleration and speed graph, including NBF Example 4.3. Explore an ideal skater who conserves L while changing I, ω and kinetic energy.

labs.title: Unit 4 Part 5 — Interactive Centrifuge Concept Lab
labs.description: Schematic spinning sample tubes, mixed versus conceptual separation, angular speed and radial acceleration demand with speed-squared scaling; not a sedimentation rate model.

labs.title: Unit 5 — Interactive Work–Energy Explorer
labs.description: Live signed-area force–displacement SVG graph, W=Fd cosθ angle slider, kinetic energy derivation/energy changes, conservative gravity vs constant path-dependent resistance, and resistive-medium stopping/reachability logic.
